description: This file defines Room database entity classes for calendar events, leaves, and astrology details, including conversion extension functions between entity and model classes for a Malayalam calendar and astrology app.

classes.name: CalendarEventEntity
classes.description: Entity class representing a calendar event for Room database storage with fields such as id, date, title, type, description, and lastModified.

classes.name: LeaveEntity
classes.description: Entity class for leave records in Room database, including id, date, title, type, description, and lastModified.

classes.name: AstrologyEntity
classes.description: Entity class holding astrology details such as id, date, raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset, specialNotes, and lastModified.

methods.name: toModel
methods.description: Converts each entity class instance to its corresponding domain model object (CalendarEvent, Leave, AstrologyDetails).

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts each domain model object to its corresponding entity class for database storage.
